cards.card_text: And the Sepharvites burn their children in the fire to the gods of Sepharvaim.
cards.verse_text: The men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, the men of Cuth made Nergal, the men of Hamath made Ashima, the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech the gods of Sepharvaim.
